details.description: Elevate your shoe-cleaning routine with the powerful Cherry Blossom Sports Shoe Cleaner. Formulated to tackle the toughest stains, this versatile cleaner works wonders on all non-leather shoes, restoring them to their former glory in just minutes. The included easy-clean brush makes application and stain removal a breeze, ensuring your favourite footwear looks its best. For best results on stubborn marks, simply run 2-3 cleaning cycles for a thorough, sparkling finish. Embrace the fresh, revitalised look of your shoes with this convenient, high-performance cleaner.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Wipe dust from the shoe surface. For canvas/mesh type shoes, lightly wet shoe surfaces for the best result.
2. Shake bottle, open cap and press against shoe surface gently to release liquid.
3. Use the brush provided to spread liquid. Do not use the foam applicator to spread.
4. Repeat application to other parts of the shoe. Let it rest for 1 minute.
5. Wipe off excess product with wet cloth/tissue.
